text:
sara: Heads-up — weekly release train bulletin for this coming deploy window. Deploy time moved to Tue 17:00–19:00 PT (short notice). Please avoid any DB schema changes or long migrations this cycle. :warning:

mike: ack. is the canary plan changed or same as last week?

sara: Canary plan update: start at 5% traffic for 30m, then 25% for 15m, then 100%. Abort criteria: error rate >= 1% or p99 latency increase > 200ms. Rolling rollback configured automatically.

linda: quick question — embeddings team saw a slight regression in eu canary yesterday. Is that addressed?

raj: we added a fallback to quantized-model-v2 for eu region; tokenizer mismatch was mitigated. Also bumped cache TTL in eu to 30s temporarily.

devops: FYI we throttled background prefetch jobs for the window and set `cache.ttl=30s` for affected stores.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT NOTICE: EU KV cache spike detected 2025-03-20T11:12:03Z. Auto-eviction engaged. See https://incidents.redwood/internal/INC-2025-102 for details.

mike: is the cache spike related to any of the feature flags for this release?

raj: not from this release branch. It was an unrelated prefetch regression that started at 10:58 UTC. We've reverted the prefetch change and metrics look stable.

sara: Given that, decision: we'll proceed but reduce initial canary to 2% and extend validation to 30m. If any of the abort criteria hit, we pause and rollback.

linda: I'll run the prompt-regression and integration suites against the 2% canary during ramp.

mike: tagging @raj for extra pager coverage during the extended validation.

oncall-bot: Pager update: raj now oncall until 21:00 PT.

sara: Quick deploy checklist (pinned in #eng-releases):
```
- no db schema changes
- migrations require approval
- feature flags set to off by default
- healthcheck endpoints green for 10m before ramp
- rollback toggle available to ops for 15m after full rollout
```

sara: Freeze reminder — library and core infra freeze starts Tue 17:00 PT. Only critical fixes allowed; freeze-exemptions require sign-off from me + @security.

mike: copying the freeze rule. we'll hold staging merges until after the window.

linda: pushing regression run now, will report back in 20m.

raj: if anyone needs a pre-canary traffic test, ping me and I'll open a short 5m smoke lane.

devops: Ops note — if you need to toggle canary early use `/canary toggle <service> --override` and ping #eng-releases.

sara: Final: proceed with caution, extended validation, and oncall watching. Post any anomalies to #incidents and tag me. :thumbsup:
